description: The DECOUPLED display node — draw a grid-field OR a bare matrix on the canvas as a heatmap, categorical labels, or D8 flow arrows. Lets the compute grid nodes run value-only (their Preview off) while ONE render node shows the result. Forwards the grid on.
instructions:
Wire a grid into this node to DRAW it — display is separate from computation, so turn the compute nodes' Preview OFF and let this node visualise the result. Toggle this node's EYE to hide/show its render on the canvas.

TWO INPUTS:
 • Geometry input — a grid-FIELD (Fill Depressions, Flow Accumulation, Watershed, Grid Threshold, …). Keeps the field's own world frame.
 • valin-matrix — a bare MATRIX value (val-matrix from Grid Geometry / Transpose / Inverse). A matrix has no world frame, so it's placed with Cell size + Origin X/Y — OFFSET the origin to sit the result BESIDE the source grid (so you can compare, or hide one and show the other).

MODE:
 • Heatmap — a Low→High colour ramp over the cell values.
 • Categorical — a distinct hue per integer value (basins, masks, labels).
 • Arrows — heatmap cells + a short arrow per cell along its D8 flow direction (needs a field carrying `dir`).

Vector results (Marching Squares contours, watershed outlines) are polylines — send those to Polygon / Network, not here.
